name: B10-0405/2026 (PPE) – Deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Hong Kong and Chinese authorities for using security laws to silence critics. It names four people held or convicted: bookseller Leticia Wong, activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, and publisher Jimmy Lai. It asks for their release, for charges to be dropped, and for European Union countries to consider sanctions on officials blamed for rights abuses.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It concerns Hong Kong authorities and four named detainees, plus other jailed journalists.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union bodies, China and Hong Kong; sanctions depend on European Union governments.
